channel.title: Food Service Director - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Food Service Director (foodservicedirector.com)

item.title: Keys to the kingdom: Disney alum trains on creating magical guest experiences
item.description: The University of Houston and Chartwells Higher Education teamed up with Disney hospitality-alum John Formica to conjure a bit of magic in their campus dining services.

item.title: Guckenheimer announces a new director of culinary development and more foodservice news you may have missed this week
item.description: Also in this week’s 5 things with FSD: Sodexo surpasses its donation goal for its annual food drive.

item.title: Prestigious Silver Plate Awards are announced
item.description: IFMA The Food Away from Home Association is honoring career achievements of nine industry leaders from both commercial and noncommercial foodservice.

item.title: Take part in FSD's 2026 Best Healthcare Recipe Contest
item.description: Healthcare operators can submit an entry for a chance to have their recipe featured on our website.

item.title: Meet the people behind the local flavors of Carnegie Mellon University
item.description: In this special tasting tour, come along behind the scenes to hear from business owners, founders, managers and chefs who have roots around the globe, resulting in a whole lot of stop-you-in-your tracks quality eats, all over campus.

item.title: Milk on the move: Tennessee schools receive portable milk dispensers through state grant
item.description: The Dairy Alliance has been bringing the portable dispensers to schools across the state through an endowment grant by the Tennessee Department of Agriculture. The dispensers eliminate heavy lifting for staff while giving students a self-serve experience in school cafeterias.

item.title: Brown Butter Roasted Sablefish with Garlic Soy Glaze and Seaweed Salad
item.description: Brown butter has been seen hanging out with seafood on a lot of menus lately. In this recipe from the Alaska Seafood Marketing Institute, it mingles with the wild and kelpy flavors of wakame and hijiki.

item.title: Mezzelune di Zucca with Brown Butter, Walnuts and Sage
item.description: In this recipe from Chef Michael Mayer of La Fuga, a Fort Lauderdale restaurant, mezzelune (half-moon) pasta is stuffed with butternut squash and mascarpone. The brown butter sauce is spiked with walnuts, nutmeg and sage.

item.title: What today’s senior living residents look for when they sit down for a meal
item.description: Today's seniors are 'Food Explorers' seeking global dining adventures, personalized diets and more, says Restaura Hospitality Group Chief Culinary Officer Matthew Thompson. Senior living operators will have to find ways to meet those needs and continue to stay on top of food trends as we head deeper into 2026.

item.title: Sodexo adds 15 new sites to Adventist Health partnership
item.description: The contract management provider and healthcare system — both giants — are expanding to a total of 26 sites and adding more than 400 employees in a multi-year deal.
